_: FOUR SHAPES — nest_3. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/nest_3.json
One capture per screen, one per wing's signature moment, and the pair the
__: level is actually about: A1 shut and A1 open, from the tile Kaya throws
___: the blade from — one throw, one frame, and the gold stones overhead shift
____: a column at the same time. Two more show the far end of that same throw:
_____: the quench's sluice on a fresh level (shut) and after it (open).

_: GOTCHAS, all of them paid for at least once in this project:
__: * a bare {"settle": n} is a NO-OP — `settle` is only read by `scenario`
___: and `teleport`. Use {"wait": n}.
____: * teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of a 22 px body on the tile's top-left, so
_____: her feet land 6 px into the row below. Onto solid rock that pushes her
______: up and she stands on the row you named; onto a ONE-WAY tread she falls
_______: through it, so aim a row high and let her drop.
________: * teleporting onto the exit tile completes the level and the capture
_________: lands on the hub. Stand beside it.
__________: * settle 210 rather than 90: the level-title card is still up at 90.
___________: * a teleport does not change FORM. Land on the pad's own tile and wait,
____________: then teleport on — TransformPad's box is the tile grown by 3 px.

_: A — THE FORGE FLOOR, screen (0,1). Spawn, the shard trench two tiles
__: east, the chain at col 11 and the two shelves it serves. Everything the
___: human wing is, in one frame, with the gold door shut at the far right.

_: B — THE SHARD TRENCH. Two tiles of hole and three of travel, which is
__: LIMITS["human"]["gap"]. The shards at row 28 are the level's only hazard
___: on a walked lane and they emit, so the hole announces itself.

_: C — THE CHAIN. `can_climb` is true in data/forms/human.json and false in
__: the other three, so this is the one piece of terrain in the game that is
___: hers. Hold up and let her go: the shelf she lands on is at row 19.

_: the chain is seven tiles and climb_speed is 60 px/s, so 112 frames is
__: the whole of it and 120 walks her off the top into a fall. 90 leaves her
___: one tile short; step right onto the shelf the climb() landing promises.

_: D — THE THROW, BEFORE. Stand on the chain shelf's east lip at (15,19)
__: looking across the gap: switch_a on the far shelf, the gold lattice
___: hanging under her feet, and — bottom right of frame — A1 SHUT at col 23.
____: boomerang_blade is max_range 118 px at speed 205 with rise -8: flat, and
_____: the lever is four tiles away.

_: E — THE THROW, AFTER. One press of attack. The blade crosses the gap,
__: trips the lever, and comes back: A1 opens, the lattice shifts one column,
___: and the sluice four screens away opens with them. She has not moved.

_: F — THE DOOR SHE OPENED, from the floor. A1 is two rows of gold in one
__: column of nest_block, and past it the airlock: pad_human at col 26 and
___: pad_frog at col 30, four tiles apart so neither can flip her twice.

_: G — THE FLUE, screen (1,1). Land on pad_frog and wait for it to take,
__: then up the shaft. The shelves are three rows apart — the frog's measured
___: ceiling and one tile past the human's — and the shaft's two walls are one
____: tile off each shoulder, so an overshoot meets rock and clings to it.

_: H — THE LID AND THE LEVER, the level's commitment in one frame. She is
__: in the head corridor with switch_b beside her; the lid B2 at col 44 is
___: OPEN behind her, because group 2 starts OFF. Throwing it shuts the way
____: she came and opens the bird's door two screens away.

_: I — THE SAME FRAME, AFTER. Walk west onto the lever. B2 is magenta and
__: solid now: everything below is sealed, and the lever that undoes it is
___: the one she is standing on.

_: J — THE AERIE, screen (1,0). pad_bird is at col 36 under the chimney;
__: take it, then out onto the first perch. No thermals in this world — the
___: bird pays for every tile out of max_stamina 100, and the perches are the
____: only things that give it back.

_: K — THE DOOR THE FROG OPENED. Perch 2 at cols 26-28 and B1 at col 25,
__: rows 5-6, standing open because of a lever in another wing two screens
___: east. The mid wall at col 30 is what makes the crossing flight.

_: L — THE QUENCH, screen (0,0). The bird's ledge at cols 22-24, pad_fish
__: on its west tile, and seven tiles of still water under six of air. Take
___: the pad and let her drop off the lip.

_: M — THE SLUICE, OPEN. The far end of the throw in frame E: A2 at col 12,
__: rows 10-12, the only window in a wall that runs from three rows above the
___: surface down to the bed. Gold, because Kaya moved it.

_: N — THE BANK AND THE EXIT. The bank's cap is the water's own surface row
__: so the hop out is one tile (surface_hop -210 against gravity 900 is
___: 24.5 px); the two nest_ledge tiles at cols 2-3 row 9 are the submerged
____: step a HUMAN who fell in jumps from, which is the other half of ADR 004.
_____: Stand at col 6 — the exit is at col 7 and teleporting onto it ends the

_: O — off the sheet: THE SLUICE, SHUT. Reload, so group 1 is back ON and
__: the level is in its shipped state, and look at the same wall. This is the
___: braid: the door at the bottom of the last room is the lever in the first.

_: P — off the sheet: THE SHOULDER BREAK at col 43, with a heart behind
__: it. `cracked_stone` carries break_hold 0.35 and FormBase.tick_break runs
___: for every form, so the frog — which has no weapon at all — opens it too.
____: MEASURED: _break_target_of returns nothing unless `attack` is HELD, so
_____: this is hold-attack-AND-press and not leaning. The first capture held
______: only left for a second and a half and the wall did not move. Off the
_______: proved route either way: the prover has no ATTACK in its alphabet.

_: Q — off the sheet: THE BLADE VAULT at col 3. nest_crust declares no
__: break_hold at all, so shouldering does nothing and only the blade opens
___: it. A weapon-only wall in the wing of the only form with a weapon.
